- [DepthFirstSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/DepthFirstSearch.java#L7) now validates `startVertex` directly with `Objects.checkIndex(...)` instead of calling into `Graph` just to trigger validation.
- [DepthFirstSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/DepthFirstSearchTest.java#L3) was updated to use the simplified graph API.
